reason: If the moms in our kindergarten group say it is good, I might download the free part and see if my child likes it, but 25 thousand every month for a phone game is real money for our family when the kindergarten already teaches letters. Nobody in the group has mentioned Kiddo yet, so I have no reason to pay.
objection: Our internet is slow and limited, so I worry a big app will eat my traffic and space before it even works offline, and I do not know if paying for PRO gives anything more than the free part.
would_change_my_mind: Several mothers in the kindergarten Telegram group saying their child really learned letters with it, and the free part working fine on our phone with our slow internet.
